{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if there are any refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
tab_channel_segment = pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment'])
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', tab_channel_segment)"}
